notes_for_editor: Most of the story rests on one 2017 email quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, from a private party. Its details (the 80-foot tower, the removal c.2006, the festival grounds, the cab and clock, the 2014 disco ball) are attributed to the email and not independently confirmed. Tennessee Landforms also lists an Arnold AFB record in Franklin County (1,112 ft, removed), which may be a separate tower or a misfiled entry; the sources do not settle it. The sources read do not explicitly tie Arnold Air Force Base to AEDC, so the story keeps the names separate. The tower's current location (the festival grounds per the email) is unverified; a search of the Bonnaroo grounds would be the next check. The writer is not named in the story.
